headline: Tulip Siddiq says she is considering legal action against former Bangladesh leader

members.title: Tulip Siddiq says she is considering legal action against former Bangladesh leader
members.lead: Former minister, who was sentenced to prison in Bangladesh in her absence, says she was victim of ‘malicious prosecution’ The former minister Tulip Siddiq has said she is considering taking legal action against the former interim leader of Bangladesh over corruption allegations made by his administration led her to resign from the UK government last year. The MP for Hampstead and Highgate, whose aunt Sheikh Hasina was put on trial in absentia over crimes against humanity during her 15 years as prime minister of Bangladesh, was accused of benefiting from the former regime by the authorities in the Bangladeshi capital, Dhaka. Continue reading...

members.title: Tulip Siddiq plans to sue former interim govt chief Yunus
members.lead: Former British minister Tulip Siddiq has said she plans to take legal action against former Bangladesh interim government chief Professor Muhammad Yunus, accusing his administration of malicious prosecution over corruption allegations. “I had been the victim of a malicious prosecution,” The Guardian quoted her as telling Politics Unleashed. Siddiq resigned from the UK government amid allegations that she had benefited from her aunt Sheikh Hasina’s regime in Bangladesh. . In December 2025, a Bangladeshi court sentenced her to two years in prison after trying her in absentia in a corruption case. She was found guilty of influencing Hasina to secure a plot of land for her family on the outskirts of Dhaka. Siddiq has strongly denied the allegations and is unlikely to serve the sentence as she is based in London.
